mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL falls below 280 (index), it indicates disinflationary pressure that allows central banks to maintain low interest rates, boosting equity valuations through reduced real rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL < 280.0 occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or correlation with returns is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 4.0% and INDPRO above 100.0 indicates tight labor markets and robust industrial output, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition (UNRATE < 4.0% AND INDPRO > 100.0) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or interaction term in regression is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%), rate cuts lower risk-free rates and increase equity attractiveness, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital flows shift toward equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 5.0% occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances, or average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1700 thousand units signals robust housing demand, indicating strong consumer spending and economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1700.0 occurs but SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO rising above 100.0 (index) reflects expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100.0 occurs but SPX 60-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or correlation with returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals strengthening employment, increasing consumer spending power and corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS above 625,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, reducing recession risk and supporting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 625000.0 occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.
